```yaml
name: Publish Binaries to GitHub Releases

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install Deno
      run: |
        curl -fsSL https://deno.land/x/install/install.sh | sh
        export PATH="$HOME/.deno/bin:$PATH"

    - name: Build binaries
      run: deno compile --allow-all --output ./bin/invidious-companion-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ./src/main.ts
      env:
        DENO_FLAGS: "--allow-all"

    - name: Upload binaries to release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
      with:
        files: |
          bin/invidious-companion-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
          bin/invidious-companion-x86_64-apple-darwin
          bin/invidious-companion-aarch64-apple-darwin
          bin/invidious-companion-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          bin/invidious-companion-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
